core_categories: Pharmacy and Health; Beauty and Cosmetics; Convenience and Grocery; Personal and Family Care; Home Health Care
specialty_focus: Pharmaprix is a Canadian retail pharmacy chain (Quebec banner of Shoppers Drug Mart) owned by Loblaw Companies Limited. It specializes in patient care services such as medication reviews, chronic disease management, and pharmacist-administered injections, as well as specialty health networks for complex chronic conditions and long-term care pharmacy solutions via MediSystem. It also offers home health care products like mobility equipment and home medical supplies, but it is not a specialist in wearable medical devices.
key_brands: Life Brand, Quo Beauty, PC Optimum, Rialto Naturals, President's Choice, Procter & Gamble, Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Unilever, McKesson Canada, AmerisourceBergen/Cencora, Sensodyne, others
